payload.title: Measure Qwen4B confidence calibration and verification/reseed rescue on stable wrong attractors
payload.work_clay: after the conservative V2 receipt, run a larger deterministic held-out/OOD real-Qwen experiment on the same pinned local-model lane. Compare ordinary continuation with an answer-key-free independent verification/reseed branch. Measure verbalized-confidence calibration, high-confidence-wrong rate, correction of initially wrong answers, regression of initially correct answers, selective risk, latency/token cost and W4 halt/route behavior. The policy/verifier must never receive the expected answer.
payload.reason_clay: the first real Qwen4B receipt contains a stable wrong modular answer (4 instead of 2) with visible confidence 100% across recurrence. This falsifies treating raw visible confidence as calibrated correctness. Recent primary self-correction/calibration research also treats verification quality as a distinct problem rather than assuming confidence equals truth.
payload.completion_clay: a reproducible Hostinger receipt covers a preregistered deterministic task set larger than the four-task pilot, exact model/runtime pins, no answer-key visibility to controller/verifier, fixed continuation versus independent verification/reseed, Brier/ECE or explicitly justified calibration metrics, high-confidence-wrong/selective-risk measures, correction/regression counts, cost/latency, and a decision whether raw verbalized confidence remains an admitted W4 residual-pressure input, is recalibrated, is demoted, or is paired with independent verification evidence
evidence_need: held-out deterministic task manifest with expected answers hidden from model/controller
false halt / missed correction / correct-to-wrong regression
calibration metric definitions and sample-size caveats
payload.executor_policy: offline shadow or evaluation only; no online Frank controller authority. Verification prompts may request a different method but may not contain expected answers or correctness feedback. Preserve every wrong/high-confidence and regression case as evidence. Do not optimize one confidence scalar as truth.
invalidators: task set too small or homogeneous for claimed calibration conclusion
new evidence makes visible-confidence proxy irrelevant to current controller
